name: wired-cio-lead-scanner-legacy
description: The current, live Wired CIO Unified Lead Scanner — single-file vanilla JS app. This is the behavioral reference for the React/TypeScript rebuild happening in ../app — every test here is the acceptance bar that rebuild has to clear.

scripts.build: node build-unified.js && node extension/build-extension.js && node web/build-web.js
scripts.test: for f in test-*.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; node "$f" || exit 1; done
